name: DailyTxT
description: An encrypted diary for one entry a day

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your encrypted diary entries, files and users, plus the secret token. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: DailyTxT web app, published on host as 7007

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: ALLOW_REGISTRATION
variables.description: true lets anyone who can open DailyTxT make an account. Register yours first, then set false (or switch it in the admin panel when you need it).

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the admin panel. Leave blank and IceStore makes one on first start and shows it in the app's log under CREDENTIALS.
